Rewrote prerequisite grammar with clear negative constraint.
Rebuilt five ordering sets around linked syntax boundaries.

Integrated response3/4 share one dialogue, retain distinct questions and independent 15-second answer windows.

27 option sets revised to remove systematic length clue; four later printed-only refinements retain keys and semantics.
Sixteen repeated concluding turns/paragraphs removed or shortened, retaining deciding evidence.
Integrated questions identify target speakers by observation/indoor checking roles.
